seo.title: Case Study — ACTED
seo.description: How an internal audit assignment at ACTED (DR Congo) reduced non-compliance risk by 87.2% in 3 months.

keyStat.caption: reduction in non-compliance risk, in 3 months — figure as documented on the CV.

context.heading: Context
context.body: From June 2023 to February 2024, Benjamin served as Area Manager, Audit, Transparency & Compliance, at ACTED in the DR Congo. The assignment covered North Équateur, on the FLZ and EKU programs, funded by donor BHA (Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance).

scope.heading: Assignment scope
scope.item1: Cross-functional internal audits across four areas: Supply Chain, Finance, HR and Programs.
scope.item2: Preparation of external audit files for donor BHA, on the FLZ and EKU programs (North Équateur).

methodology.heading: Methodological framework
methodology.intro: The same framework Benjamin applies to every internal audit assignment — presented in detail in the <link>Internal Audit & Controls practice</link> of this site.

sidebar.body: Have a similar field assignment to run? Describe your need — internal audit, procedures manual, preparation of a donor file.
